objective: Make the build-dsh-plugin workflow accurately distinguish Desktop-specific UI adaptation from installability and defer DSH Desktop compatibility decisions to the official plugin manager.
decisions: A Desktop compatibility/profile label describes separately evidenced Desktop-specific client experience; it is not an install gate.
Catalog admission and security status remain independent; Catalog-blocked entries remain unavailable through the Store.
For an approved fixed-source entry installed inside DSH Desktop, inspect and installation are owned by the official Desktop pluginManager; a host-only plugin may still be installable.
This documentation release does not change DSH core, @deepseek-ai packages, a real Profile, or the Catalog status of build-dsh-plugin.
